subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous word is **"Exclaimation".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given Options the incorrectly spelled word is **'Exclaimation'.**
 
• Its correct spelling is** 'Exclamation'.**
 
• **Exclamation! is **a short sound, word, or phrase that you say suddenly because of strong emotion, pain, etc
 
 
• ***Example:*** *‘Ouch!’ is an **exclamation.***
 
 
 
• ***​*****Thus, **the correct answer** is option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the** meaning of the other options **:

 
 
• **Correspondence**: the action of writing, receiving, and reading letters, especially between two people.
 
• **Disciplinarian**: a person who believes in or practices firm discipline.
 
• **Miscellaneous**: consisting of many different types of things.
